title: Prominence™ II: Hasturian Era
description: Lore-rich RPG modpack built on custom content. Level up and get stronger with the Talent Tree, forge and upgrade your own artifact weapon, and fight powerful bosses to stop the Void’s invasion.
author: ElocinDev
body:
Get a 25% OFF Server using code ELOCIN

Prominence II RPG

Discord Support us on Patreon Get a Server with 25% off

![Prominence features lots of custom content. Including quests, custom end game gear, and two story campaigns that unlock with the player's progression.](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1849/685/1-webp.webp) ![The Capital City you can access at any time, full of NPCs, secrets, and more!](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1849/689/2_vaaz-webp.webp) ![The modpack also features a custom talent tree with 10 fates, +16 passive talents, +5 active abilities and +100 stat talents. This allows you to make your own class with a unique talent build and gear.](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1179/305/1-webp.webp) The modpack also features a custom player leveling system, with mob scaling and multiplayer support. Showcase of the dialogue systems with voice acting and interactive dialogues. Prominence features a handcrafted design with custom textures on its own volcanic-like style. From simple UI changes to custom GUIs, changed textures, a custom hotbar and more! Primordial Forge endgame armor sets Mythic Challenges endgame boss encounters Transmogrification: Choose your own style. You can transmog any item into another item, so you're able to turn into anything while keeping the same powerful gear.

Get a 25% OFF Server using code ELOCIN

### 🧭 Built on Custom Content **You are one of the Flameborn of Vaaz, a race created by S'kellak, the Creator of All Things, to protect and ensure the balance of all realms.** **After thousands of years of peace, a ravenous force known as the Void has started an invasion into the universal realms. Worlds filled with life and death are now threatened with being destroyed completely.** **Will you fulfill your mission and stop the Void's Invasion?** *Prominence is a modpack built on Custom Content, based on its lore universe.* *Get ready for v4.0, the Kingdom of Vaaz Update, featuring for the first time in a Minecraft modpack a fully functional capital city filled with NPCs, which you will be able to visit at any point of the campaign, and which will evolve as you progress through the quests and eventually reach the Hasturian Era.*

⭐ Feature Overview ⭐

📜 **Quests and Story Campaign** Guide yourself through the mods with interactive quests. Explore two major storylines: **The Void's Invasion** and **The Hasturian Era**. The story campaign unlocks progressively, tying together **lore**, **narrative**, and your character's **progression**. 🌋 **The Kingdom of Vaaz** A fully fledged **capital city**, home of the **Flameborn**, **Dwarven** and **Serkonid**. 🐍 Find various NPCs with dialogues, shops and quests. ⏳ Watch it evolve with your campaign progress and change over time. 🌲 **The Talent Tree** Create your own class using a custom **Talent Tree** in Prominence's volcanic style. It features **10 fates**, **16 passive talents**, **5 active abilities**, and **100 stat talents**. Customize your build with unique talents and gear. 🔼 **Level Up Your Character** Grow stronger with a custom leveling system. Earn **talent points** every 2 levels and battle enemies that scale with your level. Includes **multiplayer support** with mob scaling. 💬 **NPC Dialogues** Two completely custom dialogue systems tied to NPCs: 🗣️ Immersive Dialogues, which contain **voice acted** (no AI used) lines and are used during campaign or important quests. 🔇 Interactive Dialogues, which use a custom screen to make players interact with the NPC, used by various NPCs across Vaaz. 🎨 **Handcrafted Design** Prominence features a distinct **volcanic visual style** crafted by **S'Kellak**. Includes a custom hotbar, custom GUI, changed textures, and a lot more immersive visual details throughout the modpack. 🔨 **Forge Your Own Endgame** Choose your own playstyle with **powerful artifacts** featuring unique abilities. Obtain the **Molten Core** through the campaign to forge artifacts. Upgrade them through their own **Upgrade Tree** by gaining Artifact Power using **Molten Remnants**. ⚔️ **The Primordial Forge: Endgame Custom Armor Sets** Forge endgame sets with unique tiered effects using the **Primordial Forge**, unlocked in Chapter II of the Hasturian Era. 💀 **Mythic Challenges: Endgame Boss Encounters** Face off against **Mythic Bosses** with **infinite scaling** difficulty, which you need to defeat before the **timer runs out**. Start at **Mythic 1** and fight increasingly harder bosses with random **affixes**. ⚠️ Up to 3 lives during multiplayer encounters; losing them makes the **Unholy Hourglass** level be reduced. 🔓 *Unlocked after completing Chapter II of the Hasturian Era.* 🧥 **Transmogrification – Choose Your Own Style** Customize the appearance of your **armor** and **weapons** using magical **Transmogrification**. Change any item's look without affecting its stats; **style freely without sacrificing power**! --- THE FOLLOWING WEBSITES ARE THE ONLY OFFICIAL WEBSITES THAT HOST PROMINENCE II CONTENT. # Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.1.4 - fixes and Removal final notice**

This update largely removes man Aquamirae items since they don't fit the game, whilst also fixing the Testosterone issue with mob spawning. Next update will be much much bigger, bringing a Option to disable the fade in aswell.

We have decided that we are removing both Bumblezone and Deeper and Darker! This removal will happen in **the next update**! More info on when exactly and what to do will follow the coming weeks.
This is part of our debloating of Prominence as both dimensions don't serve a direct purpose. Honey items will be added to Vaaz trades in the same update as these mods are being removed.
This means any block from both of these mods, including their Dimension will be gone, once the mod is removed. Sorry to all the Bee fans and the singular Deep Dark fan, if you still exist!

Your options will reset!

## Changes
- Removed all Aquamira Food items, removed most weapons
- Crossbows, Bows no longer give extra Ranged Damage when in the offhand
- Removed Zoomify as it doesnt work due to Simplyswords and Prominence now uses the Essential zoom for now

## Additions
- Added Penguins and Barnacles
- New cool Textures for Simply Bows!
- Natures Compass looks more thematic and cleaner
- Exchange trades in their respective FTB have been added for Warden Equipment, so you don't lose your foolish investment (Warden -> Netherite gear)
- Added Spanish Translations for Travelers Backpacks, Naturalist, Vinery and Ad Astra

## Fixes
- Fixed hostile mob spawn
- Fixed Derelict Spiders (jumping spiders and others) spawning in dark spots inside claims even when hostile mob spawning was turned off there
- Fixed Items glowing when thrown
 
Added Simply Bows Reforged, Artifact protection
Updated Create: Testosterone, Ambient Sounds, Friends and Foes, Iris Search, Not Enough Animations, Opac Fixes, ProgressiveVelocity
Reverted Fzzy Config to 0.7.0
Removed Zoomify

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.1.2 - Fixes and Fixes part 2531**

This is a smaller update, fixing a couple of issues.

We have decided that we are removing both Bumblezone and Deeper and Darker! This removal will happen in about 3-4 Updates! More info on when exactly and what to do will follow the coming weeks.
This is part of our debloating of Prominence as both dimensions don't serve a direct purpose. Honey items will be added to Vaaz trades in the same update as these mods are being removed.
This means any block from both of these mods, including their Dimension will be gone, once the mod is removed. Sorry to all the Bee fans and the singular Deep Dark fan, if you still exist!

## Changes
- Removed all Bosses from the Chungus tonic whitelist, so you cant skip bosses with it anymore
- Nether gauntlet now deals less damage when you are overleveled and you play on hard - we know the boss is a player favorite and Alms most hated boss
- Replaced Create:Testosterone with its official port

## Additions
- Added compatibility with Regions Unexplored and using an axe at the Cutting Board from Farmers Delight
- Allowed Roid rage to work on the Elytra (you heard that right)
- New Supplementaries Compat with soups into jars and such! More throwable bricks you can throw at your most hated Devs if you see them ingame
  
## Fixes
- Fixed some Bosses having Arrows bounce off them so you could infinitely stack arrows on them
- Fixed some players being unable to join servers via No Chat Reports
- Removed Leftover bundles from loot tables - Bundles are disabled. Please use Backpacks instead
  
Added Regions unexplored Compat, Bundles no more, Arrows no Bouncy, No Chat Reports, Create:Testosterone(the official one), Supplementaries Compat
Updated Testosterone Tweaks(previously was the unofficial one)

**v4.1.1 - The great Rebalance Part 1**

Items like Gh'aj were way too weak and as we all know, nerf Archer. So that is exactly what we did. Many more weapons have been made more viable, to encourage build variety. Just because your current build isnt mentioned here, doesn't mean it will never be adjusted or buffed/nerfed. There is many more planned changes. Changes are loosely grouped for each class.

We are also aware the the Wither currently does not drop Simplyswords and are working on a fix.

  This replaces the old "edit an offline player's dat file if offline" approach
  Triggers if any soulbound item gets either stolen from you or you dont have enough space in inventory when receiving it

### Balance Changes
- Lowered Watcher Spell Scaling from 1.25 to 0.7
- Lowered Watcher Damage Scali

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.0.5 - Defensive Enchants Rebalance and Advancements fix**

This update fixes Advancements in multiplayer only being given to some players and not all of them. Players will be able to stack multiple defensive enchants(Battle Rouse, Warding, Spellbreaking and so forth) on top of their Protection. This means sacrificing another Enchanting slot for many hybrid classes, but more survivability overall. Most of these Enchantments have been lowered to be balanced. We are working on a larger update, so stay tuned for that!

## Changes

- The following Enchantments have been lowered and made non-exclusive with Protection and its brothers: Warding(Excluded from the nerf), Battle Rouse, Spellbreaking, Evasion, Defiance, Evasion, Suppression
- These Enchants can now be found, traded for and added to already existing armor without issues
- Moved Protection from Common to Rare so it is easier found in higher Arcana Enchanting Tables
- Reason as to this change is so that it appears more often in mid-late game Enchanting Table setups
- Lowered Rarities of a few less significant Enchants to replace Protection's spot like Spellbreaking and Suppression
- Disabled the Bleed mechanic from Soulsweapons entirely as it has unintended effects, this may be changed in the future
- Added more Custom Tooltips for Lord souls and Black Ocelot Pelt and more
- Added a mod to fix GLFW sometimes not working for some users
- Fixed Advancements not being given to all players that killed the boss
- Fixed NPCs in Vaaz not wanting to talk to you because of missing Advancements
- Fixed a crash for some players with the Advancement Tab
- Fixed a few formatting issues in the Minecells Tab
- Fixed Mutant Skeleton Armor buffs being accidentally enabled
- Hammers should no longer break inside claims the player doesn't own

  
## Mods
- Added Mods: Unrestricted Enchanting, GLFW X11 Fix
- Updated Mods: Opac Fixes, Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks
- Downgraded Mods: Better Advancemen
